notes.title: Development Timeline - September Update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Development Timeline[/b][/h1]

Hi Everyone,

We had hoped to release a closed beta and updated trailer in Q4, however we made the decision to delay these until Q1 2025.

We are making solid progress this year, but 4x games truly have a wide range of systems and interactions to create, probably more than any other genre.

We want to make sure our closed beta gives an accurate representation of the depth we are planning. We released our first trailer as early as possible, to get the word out and gather supporters. We want the closed beta to have everything it needs to really show the game’s potential and make the best possible first (gameplay) impression.

To this end, we are increasing our team’s size to meet our goals.

Thanks for your patience and support!


System Spotlight: Monster Customization

The player will have customization options for all units. This gives the game more RPG-flavor and makes units feel unique. For the monsters, this could be akin to “training” them in the strategic direction you desire.

However, there are significantly more monsters to control than heroes, so we want to avoid choices becoming tedious or it may lead to decision fatigue, as the player will also make many choices on the 4X layer regarding how their kingdom progresses.

While heroes gain skill points to pick from a list of skills with varying costs, monsters gain a single skill choice at specific levels.

This choice may be a new ability, an improvement of an existing ability, or an additional use per battle of an existing ability. Monsters gain a choice of various stat bonuses at certain levels as well.

Overall, we want the player to build the armies and kingdoms they can envision with meaningful and measured choices. 

[h1][b]Unit Spotlight: Spirit Wolf[/b][/h1]

The Spirit Wolf is a highly mobile monster. It is a specialist at flanking the enemy defensive line and disrupting enemy spell casters. They can output massive damage to enemy back lines and retreat before being killed.

As Spirit Wolfs have several abilities that grant them increase mobility such as howling strike. This allows them to jump over front-line units, attack and then retreat to a safe distance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277069/04337fcb4e73cabc8e80f29fc6421ad466382f32.jpg[/img]

notes.title: October progress update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hero Customization[/b][/h1]

Happy Halloween! Let's take a look at hero cosmetic customization.

It's important that the player can easily pick out their heroes in battle. So, we are enabling heroes to modify hair styles, hair color, portraits and of course gender.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277069/bd3171761ff0fd25fb8773605bf72dc0a53b1a1b.png[/img]

[h1][b]Unit Spotlight: Slime[/b][/h1]
Slimes are front-line, low control cost monsters. They specializes in defense and protecting your army. The Slime is also the most versatile monster, being able to upgrade to fit almost any role your army requires.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277069/006557180c40f67e55e0b28cc15023fcb6252090.png[/img]

Slimes start out as a simple defensive tank with a protection ability. As they grow they can evolve into 4 different paths to become a healer, mage, ranged, or improve their tanking abilities. Because they are a low control cost unit, they are able to fill gaps in army capabilities as they grow in strength.

notes.title: July progress update
notes.content:
[h1][b]Research[/b][/h1]

This past month we have been working on finishing up the research system for the strategic portion of the game.

Research is one of the pillars of the 4X genre, so we've debated the direction we would take. Ultimately we decided on a standard tech tree, with multiple branches. This allows planning on the direction you want to take with each game, verses the randomized techs some newer 4Xs have. To improve replayability the branches will be customizable per game as a world setting.

Each branch will roughly cover one area of the game with some blending between different types.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277069/e833665dc58b8b10848007852dcf1fd86cc9c51c.png[/img]

[h1][b]Prismwing[/b][/h1]
The Prismwing is a highly mobile flying monster. It excels at protecting allied units from spells as well as flanking and disrupting enemy spell casters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43277069/523a0c09b03ea1dc60aced7aba9981dbead8b927.png[/img]

Prismwings use their flight to pass over enemies, allies, or obstacles to best position themselves. They start with anti-heal, which prevents enemy spell-casters from healing their allies. They are also able to unlock silence, magic barrier and minor healing abilities.
